shared_elements: large single figure in strict profile facing left/right
elaborately patterned hair/beard rendered as regular rows of tight curls or beads
garment with beaded/fringed edging and rosette or floral detail
wing or feathered element behind the shoulder
low relief with incised interior detailing on a flat rectangular slab
justification: Both depict a large profile figure with a wing behind the shoulder, an arm raised across the body, a dangling earring, a banded dotted headdress and hair/beard rendered as rows of tight regular curls with beaded, fringed garment edges \u2014 a highly conventional and specific set of rendering habits unlikely to arise independently. The main differences in content are that A's figure has a raptor's head and holds a bucket and cone between flanking stylised plants under an inscription band, whereas B shows a human bearded head at close range with no attributes or flanking motifs visible.
